name: NotebookLM
one_liner: AI notebook tool (now branded Gemini Notebook) that ingests user sources and generates insights; has a personal REST API plus MCP server in Public Preview and a separate Enterprise API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 bearer token with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/notebook plus x-goog-user-project header; personal Google Accounts only during Public Preview (Workspace fails 403). Enterprise API (discoveryengine v1alpha) uses gcloud user access tokens and needs a license plus roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser.
access_notes: Personal API: enable notebook.googleapis.com in own Cloud project, OAuth with personal Google account that signed in to Gemini Notebook once; no paid plan stated in prerequisites. Enterprise API requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise licenses. Public Preview, pricing/quota of personal API not stated.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API (7 methods: notebooks create/get/list/patch, sources create/get/list) and official MCP server, but Public Preview and personal Google accounts only; Enterprise variant needs paid licenses.

disputes.why: Quickstart lists only a personal Google account, one sign-in and enabling the API in own Cloud project; no paid plan or waitlist stated (cost not explicit).
REST reference lists 4 notebooks methods and 3 sources methods (7 total).
Google docs describe a remote MCP server at notebook.googleapis.com/mcp.
Docs root is the proper entry point.
